people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: He said to David, “You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me, whereas I have done evil to you.
translations.bsb: and said to David, “You are more righteous than I, for you have rewarded me with good, though I have rewarded you with evil.
translations.kjv: And he said to David, Thou art more righteous than I: for thou hast rewarded me good, whereas I have rewarded thee evil.
translations.asv: And he said to David, Thou art more righteous than I; for thou hast rendered unto me good, whereas I have rendered unto thee evil.
